meta_note: HTTP routes are prefixed with /api/export and protected by ApiGuard (JWT bearer). Generation runs in-process in the API gateway: data is fetched from the Finance microservice via gRPC, then passed to format-specific generators. Results are cached in Redis (TTL 3600 s) unless force=true.

conventions.free_plan_cap: FREE users have startDate silently clamped to the last ANALYTICS_MONTHS_LIMIT × 30 days (6 × 30 = 180 days). Pro users receive the requested window unchanged.

generateExport.description: Generate or return a cached analytics export for the authenticated user. Validates that format is supported for the requested document type, applies the free-plan date cap, checks Redis cache (unless force=true), fetches Finance data via gRPC, runs the appropriate generator, stores the result in cache, and returns the file as base64 inside the standard envelope.

input.type: body (required) — transaction-history | monthly-summary | spending-breakdown | budget-performance | goal-progress | net-worth
input.format: body (required) — csv | xlsx | pdf | image (must be valid for type; see supported_formats_by_type)
input.startDate: body (optional) — ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; used by transaction-history, monthly-summary, net-worth
input.endDate: body (optional) — ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; used by transaction-history, monthly-summary, net-worth
input.txType: body (optional) — INCOME | EXPENSE; filters transaction-history only
input.months: body (optional, 1–12) — lookback for spending-breakdown (default 6 in service)
input.force: body (optional, boolean) — when true, bypass cache and regenerate

data.bufferBase64: string — file bytes encoded as base64
data.generatedAt: string — ISO datetime when the file was produced

responses.200: Export generated or served from cache
responses.400: Unsupported format for type, validation error, or unknown export type
responses.500: Internal server error (gRPC failure, generator failure, Puppeteer/PDFKit error)

invalidateExportCache.description: Delete all Redis keys matching export:{userId}:* for the authenticated user. Used when analytics data may have changed and stale exports should not be served.

exportService.description: Orchestrates export generation: plan cap, cache read/write, gRPC data fetch, generator dispatch.

grpc_calls_by_type.monthly-summary: getTransactionSummary → monthlySeries filtered by date range
grpc_calls_by_type.budget-performance: getBudgets({ month, year } for current calendar month)

exportCacheService.description: Redis cache for generated export buffers.

csv.generator.ts.generateTransactionCsv: UTF-8 CSV with Date, Type, Amount, Currency, Category, Merchant, Description, Notes, Source
csv.generator.ts.generateBudgetCsv: UTF-8 CSV for budget rows (not wired in ExportService dispatch today)

xlsx.generator.ts.generateTransactionXlsx: ExcelJS workbook: Transactions sheet + Summary sheet (income, expense, net, rate, count)
xlsx.generator.ts.generateBudgetXlsx: ExcelJS Budget Performance sheet with conditional Over formatting
xlsx.generator.ts.generateGoalXlsx: ExcelJS Goal Progress sheet (not wired in ExportService dispatch today)

pdf.generator.ts.generateMonthlySummaryPdf: PDFKit A4 — key metrics + month-by-month table
pdf.generator.ts.generateGoalProgressPdf: PDFKit A4 — per-goal progress blocks with pace status
pdf.generator.ts.generateNetWorthPdf: PDFKit A4 — net balance + cumulative series table
pdf.generator.ts.generateSpendingBreakdownPdf: PDFKit A4 — category breakdown from spending trend

image.generator.ts.generateSpendingBreakdownImage: Puppeteer PNG 800px — top 8 categories bar chart (dark theme)
image.generator.ts.generateNetWorthImage: Puppeteer PNG 800px — net balance + SVG area chart
